name: morning-briefing
prompt: Run python3 src/morning-briefing.py to deliver the daily morning briefing (weather, calendar, reminders, overnight Discord, pending questions, health). Speak the result if voice is connected, send as Discord DM otherwise.

name: daily-insight
prompt: Run python3 src/daily-insight.py to generate today's behavioral insight. If it produces output, include it in the morning briefing.

name: pending-questions
prompt: Run: bash scripts/cron-gate.sh pending-questions python3 src/check-pending-questions.py — notifies about unanswered pending questions (deferred when owner tasks are queued; next */30 retry covers a skipped fire).

name: sync-workspace
prompt: Run: bash scripts/cron-gate.sh sync-workspace bash scripts/sync-workspace.sh — syncs workspace (memory + notes + state/cores) to the private vault via per-host branch (requires vault.remote_url in sutando.config.local.json, or --vault-url flag; deferred when owner tasks are queued; next */30 retry covers a skipped fire). Replaces the legacy sync-memory entry (which used rsync to a separate ~/.sutando/memory-sync/ clone); sync-memory.sh still works during the transition but emits a deprecation banner.

name: obsidian-dream
prompt: Run python3 skills/obsidian-vault/scripts/dream.py for the nightly LLM-judged vault relink pass (gated by SUTANDO_OBSIDIAN_MIRROR=1 — no-op when unset). Default model: claude-opus-4-7 (override via SUTANDO_DREAM_MODEL).

name: learned-skills-scan
prompt: Run python3 skills/learned-skills/scripts/detect-learned-skills.py to scan recent task archives for repeated workflow patterns and propose candidate learned skills. Gated on state/learned-skills-enabled.sentinel (toggled from Settings → Skills → Behavior); the script exits early when the gate is off.

name: agent-landscape-digest
_comment: Cadence caveat: a true 'every 3 days' is NOT expressible in 5-field cron. `*/3` in the day-of-month field steps 1,4,7,...,31 and then RESETS at the start of each month (so the gap across a month boundary is 1-2 days, not 3 — and Feb/short months skew it further). To stay honest we approximate a ~2x/week cadence with a stable, correctly-expressible expression: DOW 1,4 (Mon & Thu) at 6:04 local. If you truly need fixed 3-day spacing, gate the prompt on an interval check (e.g. a state-file timestamp) rather than relying on the cron field.
prompt: Agent-landscape digest (Mon & Thu). Use web search to find the latest progress across personal / autonomous AI agents — Claude (Claude Code), Codex, OpenClaw, Hermes Agent (Nous), and other rising agents/frameworks. Compare each against Sutando and suggest 2-3 concrete features Sutando should adopt (be specific: which existing Sutando component it extends, and why it's worth it). Deliver as a Discord DM to the owner: python3 $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/skills/task-progress/scripts/notify.py --source discord --channel-id 1512996282140987452 --message "<digest text>". Keep it under ~1800 chars. Fires at 6:04 local Pacific (off-minute from the 6:02 daily loop-engineering digest) on Mon & Thu and tracks PST/PDT automatically. `"launchd": true` routes this through the reliable OS-level cron-runner so it fires regardless of session state.

name: proactive-notify-runner
prompt: Run python3 skills/proactive-notify/scripts/runner.py --once to fire any due Pings to the owner. Default is dry-run; pass --live to deliver.
